At `crates/runtime/src/dataaccelerator/partitioned_arrow.rs:L128`

The _source parameter in create_external_table is intentionally ignored, but the PARAMETERS declaration lists hash_index and sort_columns as supported parameters. In ArrowAccelerator, these parameters are read from source and inserted into cmd.options before creating the table. Since PartitionedArrowAccelerator ignores _source, these parameters are silently dropped—the options are never inserted into cmd and are never passed to ArrowFactory::create. Users who configure hash_index: enabled or sort_columns for a partitioned Arrow acceleration will have those settings silently ignored, leading to unexpected behavior.


the source should be used to inject these options into cmd (mirroring the logic in ArrowAccelerator)
